def: exchange (figuratively, adjustment), i.e. restoration to (the divine) favor

occurrences.text: For if the casting away of them be the reconciling of the world, what shall the receiving of them be, but life from the dead?
And all things are of God, who hath reconciled us to himself by Jesus Christ, and hath given to us the ministry of reconciliation;
To wit, that God was in Christ, reconciling the world unto himself, not imputing their trespasses unto them; and hath committed unto us the word of reconciliation.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
